job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
Are you an experienced Financial Controller who enjoys being hands-on and having a real impact on a business?

We are working with a well-established, privately owned manufacturing business looking for a commercially minded Financial Controller to take ownership of its finance function.

Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a broad, hands-on role where you'll work closely with the leadership team, providing financial insight and supporting business decisions. You'll manage one direct report and be comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting involved in the day-to-day finance activities.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Managing the day-to-day finance function, including monthly reporting, statutory accounts and compliance.
  • Leading budgeting, forecasting, cashflow and working capital management.
  • Providing manufacturing costing, inventory and margin analysis to support commercial decisions.
  • Partnering with Operations and Supply Chain to improve financial performance.
  • Driving improvements across financial systems, processes and controls.
  • Managing and supporting one direct report.

What we're looking for:
You'll be CA/CPA qualified with proven experience in a manufacturing environment. You'll have strong technical accounting skills, commercial awareness and enjoy working in a smaller team where everyone pitches in.
You'll be confident working with senior stakeholders, comfortable managing the full finance function and have a proactive approach to identifying improvements.
This opportunity will suit someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership and wants to be part of a business where their contribution makes a difference.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online or get in touch for a confidential discussion. Please use the link to apply.

job.title: Level 2 IT Support - Service Desk Contractor
job.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Level 2 IT Support / Service Desk contractor to help an East Auckland organisation keep on top of day-to-day IT support over the Christmas and summer period.
You’ll pick up Level 2 tickets, work directly with staff to resolve issues, and troubleshoot across a Microsoft environment. The work covers end-user issues, server troubleshooting and support for business applications. It’s a hands-on role where you’ll be trusted to manage your own tickets and keep people updated while you work through a fix.
What you’ll bring

  • Solid experience in a Level 2 IT support or service desk role
  • Strong troubleshooting skills in a Microsoft environment
  • Experience supporting end users, servers and business applications
  • The confidence to get started with a short handover and work independently

We’re looking to move quickly. If you can start straight away or at short notice, apply through SEEK with your CV and let us know when you’re available.

job.title: Network Designer - Fibre
job.description:
Client & Role

Our client is an established telecommunications infrastructure provider supporting the delivery, expansion and maintenance of fibre networks throughout New Zealand. With a growing pipeline of projects, they are looking to strengthen their network design capability by bringing on an experienced Fibre Network Designer.

In this role, you'll be responsible for preparing detailed fibre route designs, maintaining accurate network records and supporting field crews with the technical information needed to deliver fibre infrastructure projects safely and efficiently. You'll work closely with project teams, contractors and other stakeholders to ensure designs meet technical standards, regulatory requirements and project timelines.

The position also involves supporting network maintenance and incident management activities, including participation in an after-hours standby roster.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare detailed fibre network designs, including fibre routes, duct layouts, splicing plans and civil infrastructure requirements.
  • Develop and maintain accurate technical drawings, as-built documentation and GIS/network database records.
  • Ensure designs comply with technical standards, safety requirements, RCA regulations and Corridor Access Request (CAR) processes.
  • Work closely with field crews, contractors and project teams to resolve design queries, identify risks and support construction delivery.
  • Process Before U Dig requests and support network maintenance, fault response and incident management as part of a standby roster.

What You'll Bring

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in fibre or telecommunications network design, with hands-on experience preparing fibre routes, duct layouts and splicing plans.
  • Proficiency in CAD and GIS design tools, including producing as-built drawings and maintaining accurate network records.
  • Strong understanding of fibre infrastructure, technical design standards, RCA requirements and Corridor Access Request (CAR) processes.
  • Experience designing fibre networks for telecommunications operators, with the ability to take designs through to construction.
  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving and communication skills, a valid driver's licence and flexibility to attend site visits and participate in an after-hours standby roster.

Interested?

If you have a strong background in fibre network design and are looking for your next opportunity within New Zealand's telecommunications infrastructure sector, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or get in touch with jen@alexanderjames.co.nz

job.title: Project Coordinator
job.description:
Client & Role
Our client is a well-established organisation providing infrastructure, telecommunications and technology services across New Zealand. They play an important role in supporting the country's connectivity and infrastructure needs.

We are looking for an organised and proactive Project Coordinator to join their busy project delivery team.

Working closely with Project Managers, operational teams, suppliers and subcontractors, you'll provide coordination and administrative support across a range of infrastructure projects. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, keeping things organised and ensuring projects run smoothly from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support Project Managers with day-to-day coordination, maintaining project schedules, milestones, registers, action logs and reporting.
  • Coordinate resources, materials, suppliers, subcontractors and project logistics to support timely delivery.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, including job packs, permits, approvals, safety records and document control.
  • Assist with purchase orders, invoicing, cost tracking, timesheets and other financial administration.
  • Communicate with stakeholders, coordinate meetings, monitor project risks and outstanding actions, and support project reporting, handovers and close-out documentation.

Ideally What You Will Bring:

  • Previous experience in project coordination, administration or document control, ideally within infrastructure, telecommunications, utilities or construction.
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Confident communication skills, with experience coordinating stakeholders, suppliers and project teams.
  • Strong Microsoft 365 skills, particularly Excel, Word, Teams and SharePoint, along with experience maintaining project schedules, reports and controlled documentation.
  • A proactive and reliable approach, with the ability to identify issues early. Exposure to permits, subcontractor onboarding, project financial administration or health and safety processes would be advantageous.

If you're a proactive Project Coordinator who enjoys variety, takes ownership of their work and thrives in a busy project environment, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply today!

job.title: Drill Operator
job.description:
Client & Role

Our client is a well-established organisation providing infrastructure and telecommunications services across New Zealand. They play an important role in supporting the country's connectivity and infrastructure needs.

We are looking for an experienced Drill Locator to join their growing field operations team, supporting underground fibre installation and telecommunications infrastructure projects.

This is a nationwide, field-based role working across multiple locations throughout New Zealand. You'll be working away from home on a three-weeks-on, one-week-off roster, alongside an experienced drilling crew delivering a range of underground infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with HDD operators and field crews to safely and accurately complete planned underground drilling works.
  • Operate locating equipment to monitor and guide the drill head, ensuring accurate bore alignment, depth and direction.
  • Support the installation of underground fibre and telecommunications infrastructure across a variety of project sites.
  • Identify underground utilities, potential obstructions and site hazards while following safe drilling practices.
  • Assist with site preparation, equipment checks and maintaining accurate drilling records while ensuring work meets project and safety requirements.

Ideally What You Will Bring:

  • Previous hands-on experience as a Drill Locator within horizontal directional drilling (HDD) operations.
  • Experience working on underground utilities, fibre, telecommunications or civil infrastructure projects.
  • Confidence using drill locating equipment and interpreting bore plans, underground service information and site requirements.
  • A strong understanding of underground utility identification, health and safety procedures and working within field crews.
  • A reliable, practical and team-focused approach, with flexibility to travel nationwide and work a three-weeks-on, one-week-off roster. Relevant licences and endorsements would be advantageous.

If you're an experienced Drill Locator who enjoys hands-on work, being part of a close-knit crew and working on projects throughout New Zealand, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or get in touch to find out more about this opportunity.

job.title: Foreman and Drill Locator
job.description:
Client & Role

Our client is an established infrastructure provider supporting the delivery and expansion of fibre and telecommunications networks across New Zealand.
With a growing pipeline of projects, they are looking for an experienced Fibre Civil Crew Lead / HDD Locator to join their field operations team.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll oversee a five-person civil crew, coordinate daily site activities and carry out HDD locating to support underground fibre installations.

You'll be working across multiple locations throughout New Zealand on a three-weeks-on, one-week-off roster, with travel and working away from home required. The role is full-time, working 40 hours per week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate a five-person civil crew, managing daily work schedules, resources and site activities to ensure projects are delivered efficiently.
  • Carry out HDD drill locating, guiding Drill Operators and troubleshooting technical challenges during underground installations.
  • Identify and manage underground utilities, service crossings and potential site hazards, ensuring safe excavation practices.
  • Oversee site safety, traffic management, subcontractors and compliance with relevant quality and safety standards.
  • Maintain accurate site records, progress reports and project documentation while ensuring work is completed to the required standards.

Ideally What You Will Bring

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in HDD, underground civil construction or fibre infrastructure projects, including hands-on drill locating.
  • Previous experience leading or supervising civil crews, with the ability to coordinate daily activities and manage site priorities.
  • Strong knowledge of underground utilities, service locating, safe excavation practices and relevant health and safety requirements.
  • A full, current NZ driver's licence, with Class 4, WTR endorsements and traffic management qualifications highly advantageous.
  • A practical, hands-on leadership style with strong communication and problem-solving skills. Experience using Fieldwire or similar reporting systems would be beneficial, along with flexibility to travel nationwide.

If you're an experienced Civil Crew Lead or HDD Locator who enjoys being on the tools, leading a crew and delivering quality work in the field, we'd love to hear from you.

Ready to get out on site and lead your next project? Apply now with your CV or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Civil Operator
job.description:

Our client is an established infrastructure provider supporting the delivery and expansion of fibre and telecommunications networks across New Zealand.
With a growing pipeline of projects, they are looking for an experienced Civil Operator to join their field operations team.

This is a hands-on role where you'll work alongside a civil crew, operating machinery and supporting underground fibre installations, trenching and general civil construction activities.

Ready to get out on site and be part of the action? Apply now with your CV or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Procurement Manager
job.description:
Procurement Manager, Infrastructure Waikato

Exciting Start-Up Environment, Leadership Opportunity

  • Play a key role in establishing a new infrastructure-focused organisation
  • Lead procurement strategy, commercial contracts and supplier relationships
  • Opportunity to shape processes, build capability and make a genuine impact

The Opportunity An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Procurement Manager to join a newly established organisation responsible for delivering essential infrastructure services across the Waikato region.

Operating in a start-up environment, this organisation is at an exciting stage of its development, offering the opportunity to help shape procurement processes, establish best practices and build a high-performing function from the ground up.

Reporting to the Commercial Manager, you will take ownership of procurement activities across the business, ensuring commercial value, effective supplier relationships and robust contract management.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys building, improving and implementing processes, rather than simply maintaining established systems.
The Role As Procurement Manager, you will provide both strategic and operational leadership across procurement and commercial contracting activities.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading end-to-end procurement processes, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, tender evaluations and commercial negotiations.
  • Managing complex, high-value infrastructure contracts, ensuring strong commercial outcomes and effective risk management.
  • Developing and implementing procurement policies, frameworks and processes within a newly established organisation.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with contractors, suppliers and key stakeholders.
  • Driving cost efficiencies, value-for-money outcomes and continuous improvement.
  • Overseeing supplier performance, contract compliance and commercial risk.
  • Leading and developing a small procurement team, building capability as the organisation grows.

About You We are looking for a commercially astute procurement professional with strong experience in infrastructure procurement, ideally gained within the utilities, civil infrastructure, construction or related sectors.
You will bring:

  • Proven experience managing procurement activities and complex commercial contracts within an infrastructure environment.
  • Strong knowledge of tendering, strategic sourcing, contract negotiation and supplier management.
  • Experience working with contractors and suppliers across large-scale infrastructure or capital works programmes.
  • An understanding of procurement governance, compliance and commercial risk.

This is a unique opportunity to join an organisation at the beginning of its journey, where your expertise and input will have a direct influence on how procurement is managed moving forward.

You'll have the opportunity to build and shape a procurement function, work across significant infrastructure activities and contribute to essential services supporting communities throughout the Waikato.

If you're an experienced infrastructure procurement professional looking for an opportunity to make your mark in a growing organisation, please contact tom@alexanderjames.co.nz

job.title: Senior Business Operations / Team Leader
job.description:
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, thrives on keeping things running smoothly and has a natural ability to bring people together.

If you have a background in finance support, enjoy working with numbers and processes, and someone who likes taking ownership and making things happen, this could be the role for you.

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
The Client & Role
Our client is an established New Zealand organisation looking for an experienced Network Engineer to join their internal IT team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on, solving technical challenges and getting involved in network projects. You'll be working across a large, multi-site environment, supporting existing infrastructure while contributing to upgrades, improvements and new deployments.

The role will initially involve a mix of project delivery and BAU support, with the opportunity to become increasingly project-focused over time.

Working closely with the Network Architect and wider IT team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work while continuing to develop your technical skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support, configure and maintain network infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Deliver network upgrades, migrations and infrastructure improvement projects.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking issues across routing, switching, wireless and WAN environments.
  • Support network security, firewalls and SD-WAN connectivity.
  • Work closely with internal teams, external vendors and service providers.
  • Maintain accurate network documentation, configurations and technical procedures.
  • Assist with network monitoring, performance improvements and incident resolution.
  • Participate in an on-call roster and occasional site visits.

Key Requirements:

  • Around 5+ years' experience in network engineering, although strong intermediate candidates will also be considered.
  • Solid networking fundamentals across routing, switching, VLANs, LAN/WAN and wireless technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with networking technologies such as MikroTik, Aruba, Juniper, UniFi or Fortinet.
  • Good understanding of network security, firewalls and connectivity.
  • Experience delivering network projects, upgrades or migrations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of technical tasks.
  • Good communication skills and a positive, proactive attitude.

If you're a hands-on Network Engineer looking for a role where you can get involved in meaningful projects, develop your skills and make a real impact, please apply today or reach out to jen@alexanderjames.co.nz

job.title: Finance Manager - Project Delivery
job.description:
The Business

This large-scale, fast-paced New Zealand business plays a key role in keeping the country connected, delivering telecommunications infrastructure, network construction, ICT solutions and essential services nationwide.
With a substantial national footprint and a diverse portfolio of complex infrastructure and delivery projects, the business is looking for an experienced Finance Manager to lead the financial performance of its Project Delivery division.

The Opportunity

Reporting to a senior finance leader and managing a team of four, this is a hands-on, commercially focused role with responsibility for a $100m plus portfolio spanning major telecommunications and infrastructure projects, including mobile network builds, fibre infrastructure and network integration.
Working closely with the Chief Delivery Officer and Programme Leads, you'll play a key role in driving project profitability, improving financial visibility and addressing cost overruns across the portfolio.
This is a broad role combining technical project accounting, end-to-end financial management, commercial business partnering and people leadership. You'll need to be equally comfortable getting into the detail of project costs and WIP as you are presenting financial insights and challenging operational stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead end-to-end financial management of the Delivery portfolio, including month-end, P&L reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
  • Oversee complex project accounting, WIP, contract costing, milestone-based revenue recognition (IFRS 15) and progress claims.
  • Monitor project profitability, cost-to-complete, margins and cost overruns, identifying risks and opportunities to improve performance.
  • Partner closely with senior operational leaders and Programme Leads, providing meaningful financial insights to support commercial decisions.
  • Improve financial reporting, forecasting accuracy, processes and controls to drive greater visibility and accountability.
  • Provide financial oversight of contract pricing, tenders, renewals and commercial opportunities.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of four, maintaining high standards of delivery while building capability and engagement.

About You

You'll be an experienced Finance Manager, Commercial Finance Manager or Senior Finance Business Partner with a strong background in project-based construction, telecommunications, engineering or infrastructure environments.
Importantly, you'll understand the financial complexities of delivering large-scale projects and contracts, including revenue recognition, WIP, direct costs, project margins and forecasting.

We're looking for someone who brings:

  • Strong project accounting and contract costing experience, ideally within construction, civil infrastructure, engineering or telecommunications.
  • Sound technical knowledge of IFRS 15, WIP, milestone-based revenue recognition and project profitability.
  • Proven end-to-end financial management experience, including P&L ownership, reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the confidence to partner with, influence and challenge senior operational stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, with the ability to develop a team while maintaining accountability and delivery standards.
  • A hands-on, proactive approach, with the ability to move between financial detail and broader commercial strategy.
  • CA/CPA qualification or equivalent, with strong systems and financial modelling capability. Experience with Dynamics 365, Workbench or similar project management systems would be advantageous.

What's on Offer?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a significant project delivery portfolio within a well-established New Zealand business, with genuine scope to influence commercial performance, strengthen financial processes and develop a capable finance team.
You'll work closely with senior business leaders on complex, high-value infrastructure projects where your financial expertise and commercial input will make a tangible difference.

An attractive salary package of $150,000–$155,000 plus additional benefits, including medical and life insurance and staff concessions, is on offer.

To find out more, apply now or contact Mel Monty for a confidential discussion.
